web.named_query: ("Joshua Rudd" OR "National Security Agency (NSA)") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: Joshua Rudd stated that the research and development of AI tools is a constant effort necessary to stay ahead of foreign adversaries who are also developing AI (s1). He emphasized that advanced AI chips are foundational to achieving AI superiority, enabling rapid data processing and superior decision-making (s5). Rudd warned that delays in procuring the latest AI chips could impair Department innovation and lethality by stalling the integration of AI into weapon systems (s3). He noted that the rapid advancement of technology, including artificial intelligence, is central to the transformation of warfare (s6).
